text: I asked for Priya to be on Saturday and she's just floating over there on her own. Honestly it looks like she isn't even on the rota, which is going to cause a row with her.
Sunday is a bit thin with only Tom on it. We'd really like another pair of hands there, the book sale gets mobbed after church.
Put Maria on the Sunday one, no wait, Priya, Priya should go on Sunday and Maria stays where she is. Sorry.
Hello, could you please make the Saturday box a little bit bigger? Thank you ever so much, that's lovely.
I'm not sure what I want really. Maybe the helpers should be a different colour so you can see who's got a shift already? Or perhaps not. What would you do?

So the trustees meet on Thursday and the chair wants to see who covers what at the food bank over the weekend. Right now it's a mess in my head. Tom does Sunday and he's fine with it, Maria does Saturday, and Priya hasn't said yes to anything yet so leave her unattached for the moment, but I'd like her yellow dot to stay where it is so I remember to chase her. What I do need is a Monday box, same as the other two, to the right of everything, and Tom should be on that too since he said he's free. Thanks, you're a star.
The yellow one hasn't got a shift yet. Hook her up to whichever day has the fewest people.
and a Friday evening one as well, for the collection
Why are there three grey blobs sitting in the middle doing nothing? Nobody can tell which one is supposed to be on the tea stall. They need names on them, surely.

That arrow is the wrong way round for what I meant. The mechanic looks for a leak first and THEN does the oil, not the other way about.
Tyres: green
Add a box that says Wipers, actually Wiper blades, under the brakes one.
I always forget the battery. There ought to be a step for it somewhere before we call it finished.

The yellow thing is hard to read for the apprentices. Can it say Leak found? with the question mark instead
Is it better if the end is red, or leave it? I can't decide. Red maybe, because it's where the job stops.

My son is learning to do the service on his Fiesta and I want to stick this on the garage wall. A few things. The checks should run along the top in the order we do them, so after tyres I want a box for coolant, then one for lights, all white like the others. The oil one is a big job so make it larger than the rest. And I don't like Done being so tiny and shy at the bottom, I'd like it bigger and in the middle, he needs to feel he's finished something!
then Exhaust
Please to make the box of the brakes more big and the arrow which goes to the oil to make with dashes, thank you very much.
These keys are sitting in a lazy diagonal. A circle of fifths is supposed to be a circle, I can't teach it to a class of twelve year olds like this.
Every minor key ought to sit under its major. Am is under C and Em is under G, but there's nothing under D, and that's going to confuse people.
Add Bm under D
okay so make a new circle called a uh a major next to D no sorry A major and join it up to the D one the same as the others
Make G purple. Sorry, I meant Em. The minor one, not the major.
Thanks, that looks great. By the way do you know why Am is called the relative minor of C? My teacher never explained it.
The heading is tiny and miles away in the corner. Put it in the middle at the top and make it say Circle of Fifths.
Hmm, I wonder if the blue ones are too dark next to the red ones. Or it's fine? I just feel the minors should look softer somehow.
i need a relativ minor for evry red cirlce, like the blue ones alredy there. the D one has non

I'm putting together the floor plan for the autumn show and the curator is breathing down my neck. The way in is fine. But the little gold star, that's meant to be the cafe, and it's just floating up there with no way to get to it, so people will walk the whole route and never find a coffee. Could the route end there, after Modern art? Also I'd like the Egypt room to be much bigger, the school parties all want it, and could you add a cloakroom beside the entrance, small and gray. I'll probably change my mind about the colours later.
Visitors have no idea where to go after the last room, the star thing is just stuck there on its own. The cafe is supposed to be the end of the route!
The school groups all go to Egypt, so it really needs to look a lot bigger than Modern art. Right now they seem equal.
Dear helper, I wonder whether you might be able to add a gift shop after the modern art room? Many thanks in advance.
gift shop, small, pink
Should the entrance be in the middle? Probably not. Hmm. Actually maybe. Leave it for now, I'll ask my boss.
The room of the Romans must be joined also with the entrance, the people need a short way when they are in hurry.
Put a lift between Egypt and the Romans. No, not a lift, a staircase. Call it Stairs. And skip the colour, whatever you pick.
The room in the middle is where our new exhibition goes, so call it Gold of the Nile instead of what it says now.
The deadline is tucked in the top corner where I'd never look. It's useless as a reminder like that, I want it somewhere I can't miss it.
Delete Bank statements
I forgot the charity donation letters. There's nothing for gifts here and the accountant is bound to ask me about them.
so I need a new box that says p forty five and it goes into the tax return the same as all the other ones

I hate this time of year. Every January it's the same pile and I never know what I've got and what I haven't. This picture at least helps. Could the three paper boxes be different colours so I can see which I've already found, say green for what I have in my hand, which is only the P60 right now, and leave the other two white? The return itself looks too cheerful in orange, it's a horrible thing, so make it a sober dark colour. Anyway, thank you, my husband usually does all this and he's away.
Not sure whether the receipts should be separate for work and personal... could you split it into two? Or just put a note on it, I don't know which is neater.
Why is Blade Storm so tiny? It's the ultimate, the whole tree leads to it, it should look like it matters!
Make Rage red
I'd love a third branch between Whirlwind and Rage, something for a stealth build. Right now everyone just goes berserker and it's dull.
